verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry is a fair question for a cloud platform and its official CLI, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out for Azure or the Azure CLI. The cited items cover CLI installation, infrastructure-as-code, RBAC, cost management and outages, none of which bear on this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
